summaryZh: Gleeson 实验室研究小儿脑疾病的遗传原因与治疗，重点是中枢神经系统发育和早发神经退行。团队组建患者队列，结合动物、干细胞和脑类器官模型，研究体细胞嵌合、基因—环境作用，以及反义寡核苷酸和基因治疗。
researchQuestions: 反义寡核苷酸可通过哪些方式逆转基因突变？
如何利用类器官理解疾病基础，并通过生物工程改进模型？
如何利用基因治疗纠正突变？

evidence.quote: The Gleeson Lab has expertise in assembling cohorts of patients designed to understand disease mechanisms, with a focus on CNS development.
Using a combination of animal and stem cell models, the lab has developed ways to study the function of these individual genes and to develop new treatments.

Novel Therapeutics — asking ways in which antisense oligonucleotides can be used to reverse gene mutations. Brain Organoid Modeling — exploring how organoids can be used to understand the basis of disease, how this modeling can be improved through bioengineering, and how gene therapy can be used to correct mutations.
